name: Izumisano (Japan)
description: A white field charged at the centre with the Izumisano city emblem in red: a fan-shaped device above a stylised cross.
history: Municipal flag of Izumisano, a city in Osaka Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 1 April 1948.

features.role: Izumisano city emblem — a fan-shaped device above a stylised cross
